## Common WHERE Filters

### 基础过滤（几乎所有查询共用）
```sql
WHERE local_date = date('${grass_date}')
  AND grass_region = upper('${region}')
  AND user_id IS NOT NULL
  AND user_id != 0
```

### 按实验分配类型过滤
```sql
-- Search 场景（is_assignment_log）
AND is_assignment_log = 1

-- D&D/YMAL 推荐场景（is_dim_join）
AND is_dim_join = 1

-- RCMD 场景（白名单组合）
AND is_assignment_log = 1
AND ((is_rcmd_whitelist = 1 AND is_rcmd_service = 1) OR is_ads_whitelist = 1)
```

### 按实验层/场景过滤（精确到具体实验）
```sql
AND project_name = 'Ads'
AND scene_id = 1361       -- paidads universal
AND layer_id = 158805     -- 具体实验层 ID
```

### 日期范围过滤
```sql
AND local_date BETWEEN date('${start_date}') AND date('${end_date}')
```

### 排除特定场景（Video bug workaround）
```sql
AND exp_group_id NOT IN (
    SELECT DISTINCT group_id
    FROM abtest.shopee_experiment_admin_db__group_dimension_tab__reg_continuous_s0_live
    WHERE scene_id IN (588, 171)
)
```

## Common JOIN Patterns

### Pattern 1: 用户行为表 JOIN 实验组（最常用）
```sql
-- 先提取 user_id -> group_id 映射
CREATE TEMPORARY VIEW search_group AS
SELECT user_id, exp_group_id AS group_id
FROM srdi_mart.dim_sr_data_warehouse_abtest_user_group
WHERE local_date = date('${grass_date}')
  AND grass_region = upper('${region}')
  AND user_id IS NOT NULL AND user_id != 0
  AND is_assignment_log = 1
GROUP BY user_id, exp_group_id;

-- 再 JOIN 行为数据
SELECT group_id, SUM(impression_cnt) AS ads_imp_cnt, ...
FROM ads_performance_base tab1
INNER JOIN search_group tab2 ON tab1.user_id = tab2.user_id
GROUP BY group_id, ...;
```

### Pattern 2: MAX(exp_group_id) 去重（单用户多实验层场景）
```sql
SELECT grass_region, local_date, user_id,
       MAX(exp_group_id) AS exp_group_id
FROM srdi_mart.dim_sr_data_warehouse_abtest_user_group
WHERE local_date = date('${grass_date}')
  AND grass_region IN ('ID', 'BR', 'PH', 'TH', 'TW', 'MY', 'VN', 'SG')
  AND project_name = 'Ads'
  AND is_assignment_log = 1
  AND scene_id = 1361
  AND layer_id = 158805
GROUP BY grass_region, local_date, user_id
```

### Pattern 3: 多领域 UNION ALL（Search + RCMD Ads）
```sql
CREATE TEMPORARY VIEW abtest_user_group AS
-- Search domain
SELECT local_date AS grass_date, grass_region, user_id, exp_group_id, 'Search' AS domain
FROM srdi_mart.dim_sr_data_warehouse_abtest_user_group
WHERE is_assignment_log = 1 AND is_search_whitelist = 1 AND user_id > 0
UNION ALL
-- RCMD_Ads domain
SELECT local_date AS grass_date, grass_region, user_id, exp_group_id, 'RCMD_Ads' AS domain
FROM srdi_mart.dim_sr_data_warehouse_abtest_user_group
WHERE is_assignment_log = 1
  AND ((is_rcmd_whitelist = 1 AND is_rcmd_service = 1) OR is_ads_whitelist = 1)
  AND user_id > 0
```

### Pattern 4: 通过子查询 IN 过滤白名单用户
```sql
CREATE TEMPORARY VIEW user_exp AS
SELECT user_id, exp_group_id, 'Search' AS domain
FROM srdi_mart.dim_sr_data_warehouse_abtest_user_group
WHERE grass_region = upper('${region}')
  AND local_date = date('${grass_date}')
  AND is_assignment_log = 1
  AND is_search_whitelist = 1;

-- 在源头推白名单，减少 80%+ 下游数据量
SELECT ...
FROM mp_paidads.dws_advertise_request_benchmark_advv_1d__reg_s0_live
WHERE user_id IN (SELECT user_id FROM user_exp)
```

## Common Aggregations

### 按实验组聚合标准指标
```sql
SELECT
    group_id, common_feature,
    SUM(ads_impr_cnt) AS ads_impr_cnt,
    SUM(ads_click_cnt) AS ads_click_cnt,
    SUM(ads_direct_order_cnt) AS ads_direct_order_cnt,
    SUM(ads_broad_order_cnt) AS ads_broad_order_cnt,
    SUM(ads_direct_gmv) AS ads_direct_gmv,
    SUM(ads_revenue_usd) AS ads_revenue_usd,
    BITMAP_COUNT(TO_BITMAP(CASE WHEN ads_impr_cnt > 0 THEN user_id END)) AS ads_impr_cnt_uu
FROM ...
GROUP BY group_id, common_feature
```

### CASE-WHEN 将 group_id 映射为可读桶名
```sql
CASE
    WHEN exp_group_id = 670988 THEN 'bucket0'
    WHEN exp_group_id = 666692 THEN 'bucket1'
    WHEN exp_group_id = 666693 THEN 'bucket2'
    ELSE 'others'
END AS exp_group_id
```

### 3. ROI3 券实验分层（scene_id + layer_id 精确匹配）
```sql
SELECT
    grass_region, local_date AS grass_date, user_id,
    CASE
        WHEN exp_group_id = 670988 THEN 'bucket0'
        WHEN exp_group_id = 666692 THEN 'bucket1'
        WHEN exp_group_id = 666693 THEN 'bucket2'
        WHEN exp_group_id = 666694 THEN 'bucket3'
        WHEN exp_group_id = 666695 THEN 'bucket4'
        ELSE 'others'
    END AS exp_group_id
FROM (
    SELECT grass_region, local_date, user_id,
           MAX(exp_group_id) AS exp_group_id
    FROM srdi_mart.dim_sr_data_warehouse_abtest_user_group
    WHERE local_date = date('${bizTimeFormatter(BIZ_TIME, "yyyy-MM-dd", "-1d")}')
      AND grass_region IN ('ID', 'BR', 'PH', 'TH', 'TW', 'MY', 'VN', 'SG')
      AND project_name = 'Ads'
      AND is_assignment_log = 1
      AND scene_id = 1361
      AND layer_id = 158805
    GROUP BY grass_region, local_date, user_id
);
```

### 4. PC2 Rate 多领域实验组 UNION ALL
```sql
CREATE TEMPORARY VIEW abtest_user_group AS (
    SELECT local_date AS grass_date, grass_region, user_id, exp_group_id, 'RCMD_Ads' AS domain
    FROM srdi_mart.dim_sr_data_warehouse_abtest_user_group
    WHERE grass_region = upper('${region}')
      AND local_date BETWEEN date('${grass_date_7day}') AND date('${grass_date}')
      AND is_assignment_log = 1
      AND ((is_rcmd_whitelist = 1 AND is_rcmd_service = 1) OR is_ads_whitelist = 1)
      AND user_id > 0
    GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4
    UNION ALL
    SELECT local_date AS grass_date, grass_region, user_id, exp_group_id, 'Search' AS domain
    FROM srdi_mart.dim_sr_data_warehouse_abtest_user_group
    WHERE grass_region = upper('${region}')
      AND local_date BETWEEN date('${grass_date_7day}') AND date('${grass_date}')
      AND is_assignment_log = 1
      AND is_search_whitelist = 1
      AND user_id > 0
    GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4
);
```

### 6. 多日 AB Test 性能聚合
```sql
SELECT
    A.grass_region, A.grass_date, B.exp_group_id,
    SUM(plt_gmv) AS plt_gmv,
    SUM(expenditure_amt_usd) AS ads_rev,
    SUM(ads_direct_gmv_usd) AS direct_gmv_usd,
    SUM(ads_broad_gmv_amt_usd) AS broad_gmv_amt_usd,
    SUM(ads_direct_order_cnt) AS direct_order_cnt,
    SUM(ads_imp_cnt) AS ads_imp_cnt,
    SUM(ads_click_cnt) AS ads_click_cnt
FROM (
    SELECT grass_region, local_date AS grass_date, user_id,
           SUM(gmv) AS plt_gmv, SUM(revenue_usd) AS expenditure_amt_usd, ...
    FROM srdi_mart.dws_sr_data_warehouse_platform_user_level_benchmark_1d
    WHERE local_date BETWEEN date '${start_date}' AND date '${end_date}'
      AND grass_region IN ('ID', 'PH', 'VN', 'SG', 'TW', 'TH', 'MY')
      AND feature_detail = '__ALL__' AND scenario_tag = '__ALL__'
    GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
) A
JOIN (
    SELECT grass_region, local_date, user_id,
           CASE WHEN exp_group_id = 650116 THEN 'base_0_20' ... END AS exp_group_id
    FROM (
        SELECT grass_region, local_date, user_id,
               MAX(exp_group_id) AS exp_group_id
        FROM srdi_mart.dim_sr_data_warehouse_abtest_user_group
        WHERE grass_region IN ('ID', 'PH', 'VN', 'SG', 'TW', 'TH', 'MY')
          AND local_date BETWEEN date '${start_date}' AND date '${end_date}'
          AND project_name = 'Ads' AND is_assignment_log = 1
          AND scene_id = 1361 AND layer_id = 164284
        GROUP BY grass_region, local_date, user_id
    )
) B ON A.grass_region = B.grass_region AND A.grass_date = B.local_date AND A.user_id = B.user_id
GROUP BY A.grass_region, A.grass_date, B.exp_group_id
```

## Derived Metrics (派生指标)

本表为维表，不定义派生指标。下游通过 JOIN 该表后的聚合表达式定义指标，常见派生逻辑：
- `plt_gmv / 3 - voucher_cost` -- 平台 GMV 券后净收益
- `ads_revenue_usd / 0.5 - voucher_cost` -- 收入券后净收益
- `expenditure_amt_usd / exchange_rate` -- 本地币转 USD 广告支出
- `exp_group_id` 通过 CASE-WHEN 映射为可读 bucket name
